title: selaginella rupestris var. acanthonota
intro: Selaginella rupestris var. acanthonota, commonly known as Rock Spikemoss, is a species of plant in the family Selaginellaceae. It is a type of evergreen, mat-forming, or terrestrial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The Rock Spikemoss has been reported to possess therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation, preventing infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
